name: C++
note: Multi-paradigm systems language that evolved from C with Classes
typeSystem: Static, strong, nominal; templates for generics

typeSystemExample.caption: Generic max via a function template

runtime: Compiled to native; no managed runtime (RAII, manual/smart-pointer memory)

runtimes.name: Native (GCC / Clang / MSVC)
runtimes.role: Standard path: AOT compiled to machine code with no VM or GC.

runtimes.name: WebAssembly (Emscripten)
runtimes.role: Compiles C++ to WASM for browsers and WASM runtimes.

runtimes.name: Cling
runtimes.role: Interactive C++ interpreter from CERN, used for REPLs and notebooks.

compilers.name: GCC (g++)
compilers.role: Widely used GNU C++ compiler, especially on Linux.

compilers.name: Clang
compilers.role: LLVM frontend with fast builds and great diagnostics.

compilers.name: Intel ICX
compilers.role: LLVM-based compiler tuned for x86 performance.

concurrencyModel: OS threads (std::thread), atomics, and C++20 stackless coroutines (scheduling is library-provided)

concurrencyExample.caption: 4 workers computing i*i in parallel via std::thread
